node.title: Re^3: polishing up a json fetching script for weather data
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
system ("cat $file | jq '[.paths.get]' >7.txt");

I very strongly recommend against doing it this way, for several reasons: First, you're using the shell's features, namely piping a file into jq when that's not necessary - jq filter files works just as well. Second, you're using the single-argument form of [doc://system], and interpolating a variable into that, opening yourself up to all sorts of possible issues; I describe that and several better alternatives [id://1180578|here], in this case I might suggest capturex from [mod://IPC::System::Simple]. Third, calling an external command in the first place - everything that jq can do, you can do just as well in Perl, by parsing the JSON file into a Perl data structure and then working with that data structure.
